messages:
nina: dropping a compact draft + two hero visuals in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/hero-visuals. Need quick passes on claims, visual alt text, and lead routing.
oliver: saw it. hero A is very punchy, hero B is softer. which should be default on the blog listing? Also we reference "~3.3x lower median latency" in a callout 0 need bench details.
courtney: product prefers hero B on listing (softer) and A on the article itself (higher CTR). agree we need bench reproducibility. nina can you paste the exact command?
nina: pasted under Methods:
```
./benchkit --model rwd-3b-q4 --baseline open-3b --seq 64 --batch 16 --hw a100 --runs 250 --seed 13
```
results: median 34ms vs baseline 112ms (~3.29x). internal run date 2026-04-02.
sam_legal: legal quick note: ok to say "reduces median latency by ~3.3x in our tests" with a footnote pointing to the Methods section. please include the run date and the disclaimer "Internal benchmark; results may vary based on workload and configuration." Remove any words like "always" or "guaranteed."
maya_ops: routing: HubSpot form hidden fields: `product_interest=redwood_inference`, `lead_channel=blog_hero_v2`, `lead_source=organic_blog`. First 72h route to `launch-inbound-priority`, then to `launch-inbound`. Region split: NA->na-sales, EU->eu-sales, APAC->apac-sales. Also add contact property `content_variant=heroA` or `heroB` depending on which CTA they clicked.
oliver: CTA UTM (use this for hero A primary CTA):
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=hero&utm_campaign=july_launch&utm_content=heroA_register&lead_source=organic_blog
```
Use `hs_lead_source` prefix for HubSpot mapping.
nina: visuals: added alt text for both thumbnails and an embed for latency plot. alt for hero A: "Latency plot showing median 34ms vs baseline 112ms". alt for hero B: "Developers working with low-latency LLM inference".
sam_legal: approved with footnote added. also request a short caption under the bench figure: "Internal benchmark performed 2026-04-02; not independently audited."
maya_ops: publish request? nina what date/time do you want?
nina: target publish: 2026-07-20 09:00 PT. embargo until that time. @publish-bot please schedule and set press notification.
publish-bot: scheduled publish: 2026-07-20T16:00:00Z. embargo flag set. will notify #press and #social on release.
oliver: final small nit: change CTA text to "Register for the live demo + benchmark walkthrough (early-access priority)". nina can you lock copy by EOD Friday?
nina: locking by EOD Friday. thanks all :party_parrot:
